newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sterling seen supported just above $1.63.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sterling seen supported just above $1.63.

text.p: Sterling should remain well supported just above $1.63 after retrenching from near two-week highs around $1.6350 overnight, said analysts.

Gerry Celaya, technical analyst at American Express Bank, said cable should remain well supported around the $1.6310 area on Friday and after a brief period of consolidation it should gain impetus and challenge recent peaks.

"We are looking at $1.6350-$1.6460 area," said Celaya, though these highs are are unlikely to be scored on Friday. At 0728 GMT cable was trading at $1.6312/22 vs $1.6300/10 in late Europe on Thursday.
